name: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Traversal (State Machine)
definition: A software ray traversal algorithm for Sparse Voxel Octrees implemented as a deterministic state machine using fixed-point arithmetic to emulate an FPGA hardware raycaster.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Traversal (State Machine) is a deterministic software algorithm using fixed-point arithmetic and explicit goto-based control flow to traverse sparse voxel octrees, differing from recursive methods by employing a circular buffer stack for backtracking.
